$description: Component registry for scripts/component-export (EXPORT-STANDARD.md section 7). One entry per exported component: where it lives in Figma and the hand-checked text the exporter can't read from Figma (purpose, rules, breakpoints, known issues). Edit this file when Karl changes a decision, then re-run the exporter.

components.name: Button Primary
components.description: Primary CTA button: the one preferred action on a page. Brand-primary fill, white Noto Sans Bold 16px Title Case label, optional 16px icon left or right.
rules: **Desktop** (`Breakpoint=Desktop`): the `Button` frame hugs its label and icons (HUG horizontally) inside the variant root, which keeps an 8px left/right margin. Buttons in a row or a stack keep a 16px gap.
**Mobile** (`Breakpoint=Mobile`): the `Button` frame fills the container width (FILL) inside the same 8px margin. Stacked buttons use an 8px gap.
**Height:** 40px in every state (8px top/bottom padding with a 40px min-height). It grows only when the label wraps to a second line.
The breakpoint split is Desktop vs Mobile only; there are no per-template variants (340/768/1024/1100/1280). Use Mobile below 640px and Desktop from 640px up unless a layout says otherwise.

**Focus ring:** InFocus adds one `Focus Ring` frame, absolutely positioned 1px outside the element, with a 2px OUTSIDE stroke bound to `color/gray/black`. It draws outside the component and never changes its size or moves anything inside or around it (a 40px button reads as 46px with the ring). In CSS: `outline: 2px solid var(--mng-color-gray-black); outline-offset: 1px;` or an absolutely positioned pseudo-element; never a border or padding change.
components.breakpoints:
| Breakpoint value | Viewport (MNG templates) | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Desktop | ≥640px (768, 1024, 1100, 1280 templates) | The `Button` hugs its label and icons |
| Mobile | ≤639px (340 XS-Fold, 360 SM-Mobile templates) | The `Button` fills the container width, inside the 8px side margin |

*The viewport mapping is the export convention, not a Figma property; Figma only says Desktop / Mobile.*

components.name: Action Button
components.description: Small icon + label utility action (documented example: "Copy Link"). No box at rest; a 1px black border appears on Hover/Pressed. Figma set name: `Button Action`.
rules: Single size at every breakpoint (95×32, HUG). No Breakpoint property. It stays compact (32px), not 40px (Karl, 2026-10-02).
Width hugs icon + label; swapping the label changes the width.

**Focus ring:** InFocus adds one `Focus Ring` frame, absolutely positioned 1px outside the element, with a 2px OUTSIDE stroke bound to `color/gray/black`. It draws outside the component and never changes its size or moves anything inside or around it (a 40px button reads as 46px with the ring). In CSS: `outline: 2px solid var(--mng-color-gray-black); outline-offset: 1px;` or an absolutely positioned pseudo-element; never a border or padding change.
knownIssues: **Name swap (2026-10-02).** This documented set is `Button Action` (`7075:6357`). The older library set on the same page (`5417:3876`, formerly `Button Action`, kept for Reader Dashboard files) is now `Action Button`. The documentation frame keeps the page title "Action Button".

**Single-purpose reference.** This set only documents "Copy Link". The older `Action Button` library set bundles Resend Invitation, Link Copied, Share (Android/Apple/Unknown), Preview Most Recent, Save/Saved, Gift Article, Remove, Cancel and Delete as hidden layers, none exposed as variants. To render another action, swap the icon instance and the label text.
**Hidden trailing icon.** Every variant carries a hidden `Icon Right` (content_copy) after the label. It is never shown; ignore it when rendering.
**Margin not specified** (open spec gap, per the Figma Specifications column).

components.name: Button Linkstyle
components.description: Text-link styled button (used for disclosures and inline CTAs such as "Forgot password?"). Underlined brand-primary text at rest; a 1px brand-primary box appears on Hover/Pressed. Optional 16px icon left or right of the label (`Icon` property, added 2026-10-15).
rules: Single size at every breakpoint. No Breakpoint property. It stays compact (38px with one line), not 40px (Karl, 2026-10-02).

**Width (Karl, 2026-10-15):** the button always hugs its label. It only gets narrower when other elements in the same parent container constrain it; then the label wraps onto more lines. In Figma the `Label` is Fill + auto height inside a Hug button. `Style=1 Row` has no max width; `Style=Stacked` shows the wrapped case with a max width of 91px (115px with an icon), so the label wraps at 75px. In CSS: `display: inline-flex; max-width: 100%;` on the button and `min-width: 0` on the label, never a fixed width.

**Icon (Karl, 2026-10-15):** `Icon` = None (default) / Left / Right. Every variant has the same layers, `Icon Left` / `Label` / `Icon Right`, with the unused icons hidden, so overrides carry across variant swaps. Icon container 16×16px (sample: `new-tab` from MNG Icons), always `color/gray/min` in every state (it does not follow the label color), 8px from the label (`spacing/100`), and centered vertically on the label however many lines it wraps to (`align-items: center`; icon `flex: none`). The Hover/Pressed box and the InFocus ring surround the label and icon together.
**Text alignment when the label wraps:** `Icon=Left` is left-justified; `Icon=None` and `Icon=Right` are right-justified.

**Focus ring:** InFocus adds one `Focus Ring` frame, absolutely positioned 1px outside the element, with a 2px OUTSIDE stroke bound to `color/gray/black`. It draws outside the component and never changes its size or moves anything inside or around it (a 40px button reads as 46px with the ring). In CSS: `outline: 2px solid var(--mng-color-gray-black); outline-offset: 1px;` or an absolutely positioned pseudo-element; never a border or padding change.
**New-tab links:** the icon is decorative (`aria-hidden="true"`). A link that opens in a new tab also needs visually hidden text such as "(opens in a new tab)".
knownIssues: **Margin not specified** (open spec gap, per the Figma Specifications column).

In CSS: `outline: 2px solid var(--mng-color-gray-black); outline-offset: 1px;` or an absolutely positioned pseudo-element; never a border or padding change.
knownIssues: **Margin not specified** (open spec gap, per the Figma Specifications column).

components.name: In-Line Close
components.description: Close (X) button for in-line panels and alerts (InLineMessage, ModalsOffset). Bare 12px icon in a 40px hit area at rest; the 28px `Box` gets a white fill and 1px near-black border on Hover/Pressed.
rules: Single size at every breakpoint (40×40 hit area). No Breakpoint property.
Every state has the same layers (`Button` › `Box` › `Icon`); the `Box` has no fill or border in Default and InFocus.
Usually placed top-right of an InLineMessage panel, with the hit area aligned to the panel padding.

**Focus ring:** InFocus adds one `Focus Ring` frame, absolutely positioned 1px outside the element, with a 2px OUTSIDE stroke bound to `color/gray/black`. It draws outside the component and never changes its size or moves anything inside or around it (the ring surrounds the 40px hit area with 4px corners, matching the Hover/Pressed box). In CSS: `outline: 2px solid var(--mng-color-gray-black); outline-offset: 1px;` or an absolutely positioned pseudo-element; never a border or padding change.
knownIssues: **Margin not specified** (open spec gap, per the Figma Specifications column).

components.name: Non-Button Hyperlink
components.description: Plain in-text hyperlink (not a button). Brand-primary text with a 1px bottom border: dashed at rest, solid on Hover/Pressed, 2px teal box on InFocus. Figma set name: `Hyperlink`.
rules: Hugs its text at every breakpoint. No Breakpoint property.
Implement the underline as `border-bottom`, not `text-decoration` (that is how Figma builds it).

**Intentional, matches production (Karl, 2026-10-02):** 16.5px text, a teal (color/theme/primary) 2px focus box with 4px corners instead of the black ring, and the dashed underline kept inside the InFocus box (`Underline` › `Label`). Because the focus box is part of the layout, InFocus is 2px taller (25 vs 23px). Do not "fix" these.

components.name: Article Section Kicker
components.description: Section label above an article headline in For You cards, rows and the featured story: the article's section (articleSection), shown uppercase in the theme primary color.
rules: **Text:** the section name typed as written (`Section` text property); uppercase comes from the text case. One line.

**Type:** Noto Sans Bold 10 (`font/size/10`, `font/style/bold`), line height 12.5px (no line-height token yet), no letter spacing, matching the production top nav and Subscriber Only badge (Karl, 2026-10-23).
**Color:** `color/theme/primary`, so it changes per theme. Passes WCAG AA on white on all 96 sites (lowest 4.75:1, orlandosentinel.com).
**Size and spacing:** hugs its text, no padding. 8px (`spacing/100`) between it and the headline in For You cards and rows; 4px (`spacing/050`) in the featured story.
**Used in:** 1Col Article Card, Horizontal Thumbnail Card and Zone 1 Lead Article Card (`Style=For You`), as an exposed instance.

components.name: Article Author
components.description: Author name in the footer of For You cards and rows and in the featured story byline.
rules: **Text:** the author's name as published (`Author` text property). One line; hugs its text.
**Type:** Noto Sans Medium 12 (`font/size/12`, `font/style/medium`), line height 16px (no line-height token yet). Color `color/gray/min` (18.4:1 on white).
**Cards:** the footer has a 1px `color/gray/500` top border and 8px (`spacing/100`) above the author; the Article Timestamp sits directly under it.
**Rows and the featured story:** author and timestamp side by side, 12px apart (`spacing/150`).
**Used in:** 1Col Article Card, Horizontal Thumbnail Card and Zone 1 Lead Article Card (`Style=For You`), as an exposed instance.

components.name: Article Timestamp
components.description: Relative publish time with a clock icon, in For You cards, rows and the featured story byline.
rules: **Icon:** Icons `access-time` (production icon font U+E900), 11×11, `color/gray/200`.
**Text:** relative time ("56 mins ago", "2 hours ago", "3 days ago", "1 week ago"), `Time` text property. One line.

**Type:** Noto Sans Regular 13 (`font/size/13`, `font/style/regular`), line height auto, `color/gray/200` (6.6:1 on white). Same as production's card meta; 13px chosen over the prototype's 12px (Karl, 2026-10-23).
**Spacing:** 4px (`spacing/050`) between icon and time, centered vertically; hugs its content.
**Placement:** under the Article Author in cards; 12px (`spacing/150`) to its right in rows and the featured story.
**Used in:** 1Col Article Card, Horizontal Thumbnail Card and Zone 1 Lead Article Card (`Style=For You`), as an exposed instance.
components.production: Card meta time on production homepages: Noto Sans 13px / 400, #5E5D5C (color/gray/200).

components.name: 1Col Article Card
components.description: Single-column article card. Style=Standard (4:3 image, CardQuaternary headline, compact excerpt: section-highlight lead cards), Style=Media Lead (16:9 image, TitleMedia headline, excerpt: the Photos lead) and Style=For You (bordered card for the For You tab).
rules: **Style=For You container:** `color/gray/max` fill, 1px `color/gray/500` border, `radius/lg` (8px) corners, clips its content. No shadow.

**Style=For You content:** 16:9 Article Image Placeholder (Show Image applies); Article Section Kicker; headline in `Editorial/Titles/CardTertiaryCompact` (Noto Serif Bold 16/18.88, `color/gray/min`), max 5 lines with an ellipsis; footer with a 1px `color/gray/500` top border, Article Author with the Article Timestamp under it.

**Style=For You spacing:** 16px (`spacing/200`) body padding; 8px (`spacing/100`) between kicker and headline; 12px (`spacing/150`) between the headline group and the footer; 8px (`spacing/100`) above the author.
**Style=For You width:** fills its column, 16px between cards: 3-up from 800px, 2-up at 640–799px, 1-up below 640px. Built at 296px.

**Equal-height rows:** in code the card body is also `justify-content: space-between`, so footers line up when cards in a row stretch to the same height. Figma can't combine that with a fixed gap, so the Figma card uses the 12px gap.

**Properties:** Show Subscriber Badge, Show Excerpt and Show Meta apply to Standard and Media Lead only. Show Gallery Icon (added 2026-10-26) applies to For You: 28px badge, 6px in from the image's bottom-right corner, as in Horizontal Thumbnail Card.
knownIssues: Style=For You: hover state (primary border and ring, primary headline) not built yet (parked).

components.name: Horizontal Thumbnail Card
components.description: Horizontal article row. Style=Standard: compact thumbnail list item (Photos Block secondary list). Style=For You: the bordered For You tab article row.
rules: **Style=For You container:** `color/gray/max` fill, 1px `color/gray/500` border, `radius/lg` (8px) corners, clips its content. No shadow.

**Style=For You image:** Article Image Placeholder pinned top-left. 640px and up: 220px wide, filling the row height (minimum 132px, 5:3). Below 640px: 90×54 (Style=Standard's 90px width at the same 5:3 ratio), with white space below it (Karl, 2026-10-26).

**Style=For You body:** Article Section Kicker; headline in `Editorial/Titles/CardTertiaryCompact` (Noto Serif Bold 16/18.88, `color/gray/min`), not clamped; footer with a 1px `color/gray/500` top border, Article Author and Article Timestamp side by side.

**Style=For You spacing:** body padding 16px (`spacing/200`), 12px (`spacing/150`) below 640px; 8px (`spacing/100`) kicker to headline; 12px (`spacing/150`) headline group to footer; 8px (`spacing/100`) above the footer content; 12px (`spacing/150`) between author and timestamp.
**Style=For You width:** fills the feed column; rows stack 16px apart.
**Gallery Icon Badge** (`Show Gallery Icon`, both styles): 28px black circle with a 16px white gallery icon, 6px in from the image's bottom-right corner.

components.name: Zone 1 Lead Article Card
components.description: The homepage Zone 1 lead story. Style=Standard (production lead with Related list) and Style=For You (the For You tab featured story); Gallery=Image or Gallery=Slideshow (a photo gallery lead, which shows the Zone 1 Slideshow instead of the image).
rules: **Style=For You:** Article Section Kicker 4px (`spacing/050`) above the headline; no subscriber badge or Related list; byline after the excerpt (Article Author and Article Timestamp side by side, 12px `spacing/150` apart, 12px above).

**Headline and excerpt:** same tokens as Style=Standard (Noto Serif Bold 29/33, −0.87px at 640px and up; 25/29, −0.03em below; excerpt Noto Sans 15/19 `color/gray/100`, 4px below the headline group on Desktop and Tablet, as in production).

**Layout:** Desktop and Tablet are two columns (text, then image; 20px and 32px apart); Mobile is one column (headline group, image, excerpt, byline; 8px gaps) with a 1px bottom rule 20px below the byline.

**Gallery** (Karl, 2026-10-26): `Gallery=Slideshow` replaces the image with the Zone 1 Slideshow, as production does for gallery leads (`.feature-large .article-slideshow`). Zone 1 has no Gallery Icon Badge.

**Gallery=Slideshow layout follows the lead's width, not the screen:** two columns when the lead is about 700px wide or more (Desktop: text 295 and slideshow 356, the rest of the 706 card between them; Tablet: the slideshow fills the 358 column); one column when narrower: headline, excerpt, then the Related list (Standard) or byline (For You), then the slideshow full width. On the homepage the third page column narrows the lead, so it is one column from 800 to 1279px (594 wide at 1024) and below 640px, and two columns from 640 to 799px and from 1280px up (production, checked on develop.denverpost.com 2026-10-26).
components.breakpoints:
| Device | Viewport | Layout |
|---|---|---|
| Mobile | below 640px | One column; 25/29 headline |
| Tablet | 640px and up (768 template) | Two columns, 32px apart |
| Desktop | 1024px and up | Two columns, 20px apart (text 295, image 391) |
knownIssues: Tablet: the image (391px) is wider than its 358px column (both styles).
Column gaps 20px (spacing/250) and 32px (no token) are raw values.

components.name: Zone 1 Slideshow
components.description: Inline slideshow a Zone 1 lead shows in place of its image when the story is a photo gallery. Breakpoint = Desktop, Tablet, Mobile; Show Credit (off by default), Slide Count and Caption text properties.
rules: **Image area:** 16:9 (Desktop 356×200, Tablet 358×201, Mobile 340×191); the photo is letterboxed and centered with no background.

**Controls breakpoint (production's):** large controls (40×60 arrows, 13px count and caption, Desktop spacing) at 800px and up; small controls below 800px. The Tablet variant shows the 768 template, so it uses the small controls; from 800 to 1023px use the large ones.

**Arrows:** previous and next, 40×60 at 800px and up and 35×53 below 800px, `color/gray/black` at 75% opacity, arrow-left / arrow-right icons in `color/gray/max` (30px; 26px below 800px), vertically centered at the image area's edges.

**Text:** credit (optional) Noto Sans Bold 11 `color/gray/200`; slide count Noto Sans Bold `color/gray/black`; caption Noto Sans Regular `color/gray/200`. Count and caption `font/size/13` at 800px and up, `font/size/11` below 800px; line height auto.

**Caption block:** 12px top (`spacing/150`); 8px between lines and 16px bottom at 800px and up (`spacing/100`, `spacing/200`); 4px and 12px below 800px (`spacing/050`, `spacing/150`); 3px `color/gray/500` rule along the bottom. 12px (`spacing/150`) below the slideshow.

**Arrow states** (Slideshow Arrow set `3641:50772`: Direction × Size × State): hover has no visual change (production sets the same colors; pointer cursor). Keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`): 2px `color/gray/max` outline 3px outside the button, at the button's 75% opacity. Buttons have `aria-label` "Previous" / "Next".
**Behavior:** the gallery loops (Previous on slide 1 goes to the last slide), so production's disabled style (20% opacity) never shows. The image strip can be dragged or swiped. No dots or autoplay.
**Screen readers (required, not in production yet):** announce the slide count when the photo changes (`aria-live="polite"` on the count). Design-vs-production entry 37.
components.breakpoints:
| Lead width / viewport | Layout (set by the card) | Controls (production 800px breakpoint) |
|---|---|---|
| Lead about 700px or wider (homepage: 640–799px, 1280px and up) | Two columns: slideshow 356 (Desktop) or filling the 358 column (Tablet) | small below 800px, large from 800px |
| Lead narrower (homepage: below 640px, 800–1279px) | One column: slideshow full width after the text (and Related) | small below 800px, large from 800px |
knownIssues: Production type, spacing and colors are off-token: design-vs-production entry 36.
Production does not announce the slide count to screen readers (design-vs-production entry 37, required).

components.name: Homepage Tab
components.description: One homepage tab (For You feature: Editor's Picks / For You). State = Default, Hover, Active, Focus; Label text property.

**Colors:** Default `color/gray/200`; Hover `color/gray/min`; Active `color/gray/black` with a 2px `color/theme/primary` underline; Focus a 2px `color/gray/black` ring set 3px inside the tab.

components.name: Section Title / Eyebrow
components.description: Section header for homepage blocks and the For You feed. Style = Underline, Bold; Chevron (on by default), Show Subhead (off by default), Subhead text and Show Info properties.
rules: **Title:** the theme's eyebrow tokens (`font/theme/eyebrow-family`, `-size`, `-weight`: Bold Coastal Noto Sans 20 / 400, Measured Vibrant Noto Sans 17 / 700, Modern Earthy Noto Serif 21 / 400), uppercase, 3.5% letter spacing. Underline: `color/gray/100`, line height 22px. Bold: `color/theme/primary`, line height auto.
**Underline (Style=Underline):** 2px `color/theme/primary`, as wide as the title (the component hugs its text). Bold has no underline.
**Chevron:** 16px arrow-right icon, `color/theme/primary`; on by default.

**Spacing:** 8px (`spacing/100`) between the title row, the underline and the subhead row, and between the title and the arrow (Karl, 2026-10-27). 4px (`spacing/050`) between the subhead and the info icon. No outer padding or margins: the block that uses the title sets the space around it.
**Subhead (optional, For You feed header):** Noto Sans Regular 13 (`font/size/13`), `color/gray/200`, line height auto.
**Info (Show Info):** 12px info icon, `color/gray/200`, shown with the subhead. It is a button that opens the MNG Web Design System Tooltip, Type=Toggletip, Placement=Bottom.
**Markup:** an `h2`; the arrow is inside the section link.
knownIssues: Letter spacing (3.5%) and the Underline title's 22px line height have no tokens (none exist yet).
Production: title color wrong and underline missing on Bold Coastal and Measured Vibrant (design-vs-production entry 12.2); title-to-underline and title-to-arrow spacing off-token (entry 38).
components.production: Production `.section-highlight h2.entry-title` and `.headline-list-title` (homepage blocks, all 6 review sites).
